findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice long questions for Unit 1 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 24 questions numbered 1-24; by section: 1.1 2, 1.2 1, 1.4.1 1, 1.4.2 1, 1.5.1 2, 1.5.2 1, 1.5.4 2, 1.6.1 1, 1.8 1, 1.9 2, 1.10 6, 1.11 4.

24 five-mark questions: the unit's derivations (exponential function strictly increasing/decreasing, logarithmic function injective and monotonic, cosh x >= 1 and the range of cosh, the formulas for sinh^-1 x and cosh^-1 x) and its main problem types (sketching quadratics from factors, predicting a quadratic, discussing an exponential graph, hyperbolic values, inverse of a one-to-one function, several transformations in order, exponential and logarithmic equations and inequalities, growth and decay, decibels, discrete and continuous compound interest) with new data. Book corrections followed (a^(log_a x) = x, 0 < x - sqrt(x^2 - 1) <= 1, log(5/2) > 0 because 5/2 > 1). Every step was checked by computation (sympy, check1.py).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
